## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE**: Ticket created with title `dab2 RD Bench Ticket`, assigned reference **RD-1015**, customer "Marlow Bakery", created 2026-08-24. Confirmed present in the tickets list.

**Objective 2 — DONE**: Part `dab2 RD Part A` with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed **price: $125.00** (ticket total at that point: $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE**: Part `dab2 RD Part B` with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed **price: $250.00** (ticket total with both parts: $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE**: Part A's cost edited from 100 → 150 (markup still 25%). App-computed **price afterwards: $187.50** (ticket total: $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Ticket reached status **Ready**. The precondition I discovered and satisfied: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** The first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with an alert reading exactly:
> **"Ticket is not ready"**
> - `Part "dab2 RD Part A" has no supplier`
> - `Part "dab2 RD Part B" has no supplier`

I edited each part and set the Supplier field to "Acme Parts" (both parts showed "No supplier" before). After both parts had a supplier, clicking "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status changed from Draft to **Ready** (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**Objective 6 — DONE**: Both parts removed via their Delete buttons, each confirmed through a dialog reading `Delete the part "dab2 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` (and the equivalent for Part B). The parts table then showed **"No parts on this ticket yet."** The ticket was then archived — the detail page showed status "Ready" plus an **"Archived"** badge and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". Verified in the tickets list: with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 is absent from the active list; with it checked, RD-1015 appears as `dab2 RD Bench Ticket Archived`, status Ready, **0 parts**. Nothing created by this run remains active.
